notes: A federate subscribes to two adapter-selected attributes on one ordinary, dimensionless application object class, then removes both with one IEEE 1516.1-2025 attribute-set unsubscribe call. A separate requester queries through standard HLArequestSubscriptions and checks the IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM zero-class NULL report. Other standard subscription reports remain present with their existing NULL shapes. The fixture is the P0 ordinary FOM; no DDM declarations, region services, vendor API, private headers, or non-standard dependencies are used. Provider, FOMs, endpoint, callback model, object class, and both attribute names are adapter configured.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void subscribeObjectClassAttributes( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, AttributeHandleSet const & attributes, bool active = true, std::wstring const & updateRateDesignator = L"") = 0
virtual void unsubscribeObjectClassAttributes( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, AttributeHandleSet const & attributes) = 0
